Args:
set -eu
started=
stop() {
  if [ -z "$started" ]; then exit 0; fi
  docker stop -t 45 corpus-supervisor >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap stop TERM INT
set --
until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  set -- "$@" x
  if [ "$#" -ge 180 ]; then echo "launch: no Docker daemon after 180 s" >&2; exit 1; fi
  sleep 1
done
docker rm -f corpus-supervisor >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker pull "$SUPERVISOR_IMAGE" &
wait "$!"
started=1
docker run -d --name corpus-supervisor --restart no \
  -p 8443:8443 \
  -v /var/run/docker/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -v /run/alpha:/run/alpha \
  -e SESSION_CAP -e CHAT_IMAGE -e CORPUS_MODELS \
  -e INFERENCE_URL -e INFERENCE_REVISIONS \
  -e BROKER_URL -e BROKER_REVISIONS \
  -e GUARD_URL -e GUARD_REVISIONS \
  -e MODERATION_POLICY \
  "$SUPERVISOR_IMAGE" >/dev/null
docker wait corpus-supervisor >/tmp/code &
waiter=$!
wait "$waiter" || true
wait "$waiter" || true
code=
read -r code </tmp/code || true
case "$code" in ''|*[!0-9]*) code=1 ;; esac
exit "$code"
